column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 3: Kederon / Piripo's family
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: $$ピリポ$$... It cannot be helped now!
If you truly wish to see your parents, you must find the courage to face them directly.
B-but...
I don't care—just go see them already...
Whatever you say, they're your real family, aren't they?!
Silence, you lot!!
Do you know you're making a racket outside this village mayor's estate?!
Hm!? Who are you people...?
And this $$奴隷$$ without a $$首輪$$ who is standing and walking about...
Is he one of the $$奴隷$$s you keep?!
Yes! This $$お兄ちゃん$$ is my $$奴隷$$~!
So what if he is?!
I would like to speak privately...
with the master of this house.
It's a business matter.
Tell him $$ピリポ$$ has come, and he will understand...!
...What is all this noise?!
My lord, a $$神官$$ called $$ピリポ$$ has come...
$$ピリポ$$, you say?!
Y-you... Are you some kind of extortionist?!
U-um...
Y-you... Those white $$羽$$...?!
My lord... You know these people after all?!
I-I do not!!
I don't know people like this!!
They have probably come to find fault with our family...
They must be extortionists!!
Gentlemen bodyguards...
Never mind a word they say!
Get rid of them at once!!
Damn it... I knew it would come to this!
Tch!!
Heh heh heh...
The village mayor has always taken especially good care of us...
So you lot can have, free of charge...
a procedure from us $$強欲$$ Doctors!?
What are these guys?! They're damn fast!
Unlike other places, this village is not only unlikely to be caught up in war...
We also get heaps of wealthy patients without lifting a finger...
And the fees are collected not from the elderly, but indirectly from the young...
So the elderly think it is not their money and come to the hospital even when they do not need to...
Tch!!
And even if an operation fails, we can settle everything by saying, “They were at that age!”...
For us $$強欲$$ Doctors devoted to $$強欲$$...
this village is practically heaven!!
Never mind that! We'll carve you up inch by inch!!
Hold it right there~!!
Y-you're... that strange girl from before!!
W-what is this all of a sudden?!
Yeah, yeah, I don't care about small fry—go over there...
I thought things over by myself after that...
If you really aren't $$カイン$$...
then you must be a fake $$カイン$$, right?!
And that makes you an eyesore...
so I think you should get killed right away!!
What did you say, you little punk?!
Because if you really have $$記憶喪失$$, then to my question earlier...
you should have answered that you couldn't say either way...
But if you were the real $$カイン$$...
then you deceived me...
and left me behind!!
Either way, there is...
clearly no reason to keep you alive!!
Hey... Calm down a little!!
Aah, you're so annoying! All of you...
should just disappear forever!
